body.message: Hello Mikhail, Thank you for your message. As we mentioned previously, a deduction was applied for the removal of items left in the apartment. Additionally, during the inspection carried out after your checkout, the team identified a bedbug issue. The inspection was documented, and please find attached the receipt for the bedbug treatment conducted. Based on this, the refund has been processed accordingly, and the amount you will be receiving has been clearly stated. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation regarding this matter. Kind regards, Chahana T.
